Site policy

Terms of use.

Conditions for using Finger Lakes Soaring Club’s public website and resources.

This page is a readable replacement for the club’s existing public terms. It does not replace waivers, membership agreements, operating manuals, or aviation regulations.

Agreement

By using this website, you agree to these terms and applicable law. If you do not agree, do not use the site.

Informational purpose

Website content is provided for general information. Schedules, prices, aircraft availability, weather, policies, and operational details can change. Confirm time-sensitive information directly with the club.

No operational authority

Nothing on this website authorizes a flight, aircraft operation, membership status, qualification, maintenance action, or safety decision. Current approved documents, authorized club officers, instructors, pilots, and applicable regulations control.

Acceptable use

You may not use the site unlawfully; interfere with its operation; attempt unauthorized access; introduce malicious software; impersonate another person; or submit false, harmful, or infringing material.

Third-party links

Links to outside websites and documents are provided for convenience. FLSC does not control and is not responsible for third-party content, availability, privacy, or security.

Unless otherwise identified, club names, branding, photographs, text, and original materials are owned by or licensed to FLSC. Government documents and third-party materials retain their respective rights.

Disclaimer and limitation

The website is provided “as is” without warranties to the extent permitted by law. FLSC is not liable for losses resulting from reliance on website content, interruptions, errors, external links, or unauthorized access, except where liability cannot legally be excluded.

Access and changes

FLSC may update these terms, modify content, restrict access, or discontinue features. Continued use after an update constitutes acceptance of the revised terms.

Contact

Questions may be sent to contact@flsc.org or Finger Lakes Soaring Club, 3 Forbes Street, Dansville, NY 14437.
